uncertainty_policy.gaussian_fit_uncertainty: per-measurement diagnostic; not sampling uncertainty for tracker performance
uncertainty_policy.inference: descriptive; no confidence intervals or p-values
prohibited: binomial confidence intervals over correlated frames or gaps
reaggregation of case medians as pooled residuals

replication_units.controlled_sam2_family: single series, stratified by frozen pair (n=2)
replication_units.cu111_positive_control: single series, stratified by frozen pair (n=2)
replication_units.independent_energy_scan: series (n=2), stratified by frozen pair (four cases)

uncertainty_policy.sensitivity_analysis: leave one frozen scan-pair case out; recompute count-based outcomes only
